messages:
Maria S: Thanks for coming to the all-hands — quick follow-up on the security/privacy section. I'll capture Qs here and loop in folks.
Will H: Can we get a concrete ETA for SOC2 Type II completion? People asking if it's safe to onboard enterprise customers.
Maria S: We're targeting audit readiness by end of Q2; Type II audit scheduled for mid-Q3. Still working through control evidence collection.
Raj P: For customers asking about ISO27001, do we have a parallel plan or is SOC2 our focus right now?
Maria S: SOC2 is priority for product/legal pipeline. ISO is on roadmap; we're scoping required docs and gap analysis now — won't block enterprise pilots but will be next focus.
Emily K: Quick KMS question — will customers be able to BYOK or integrate with their KMS in Private deployments or Dedicated?
Maria S: BYOK via customer KMS/HSM is planned for Private (VPC/on-prem). For Dedicated we're adding KMS connectors (customers can bring keys via our supported integrations). Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks.
Alex C (CEO): Emphasis: Dedicated customers with compliance needs will get isolated key controls. We'll publish a KMS integration guide soon.
Will H: For Private deployments, do we need to change any agent config to enable external KMS? Could use a snippet.
Emily K: Answering — will share minimal config after this thread. Roughly: point REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT to your KMS gateway and mount the creds; we support KMS via standard REST and gRPC proxies.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: kms-proxy 0.9.2 -> staging
Raj P: Audit logs — customers want immutable audit trails. Are we streaming audit logs to customer-owned sinks (S3/Cloud Storage/LogHub) or only to our console?
Maria S: For Private: customer-owned sinks supported. For Dedicated/Hosted: we provide secure export (S3/GCS) and webhook sinks; immutable retention via object locking is possible if the customer enables it on their side.
Will H: Is there a plan for log signing or tamper-evidence so customers can verify exports?
Maria S: Yes, we're adding signatures to log batches and a content-hash manifest in the export. We'll document verification steps. ETA: prototyping now.
Emily K: Any constraints on PII in logs? We should clarify what gets redacted by default.
Maria S: Default: request/response metadata, system events, and token-level billing data. We redact full request bodies for certain sensitive endpoints; customers can configure additional redaction rules in Private/Dedicated.
Will H: For hosted API customers worried about data residency — do we have region-level guarantees for log storage?
Maria S: Yes — logs are stored in-region for requests routed to that region; customers can opt into multi-region replication but default stays in-region for compliance.
Raj P: Follow-up: If a customer requests SOC2 evidence (e.g., access logs for a period), what's the process and SLA?
Maria S: Submit a support package request with scope; for Dedicated/Private customers we have a 3-business-day SLA for evidence pulls. Hosted customers: depends on plan, usually 5-7 business days.
Will H: Are we tracking who's viewed audit logs in the console? Need an internal audit trail for access.
Maria S: Yes — console access and audit log exports themselves are audited. We'll include viewer identity and action in the log metadata.
Alex C (CEO): We're committed to transparency. If any sales/customer team has specific compliance asks, DM Maria and Raj so we can prioritize.
Emily K: I'll add a short FAQ for developers on what is logged and how to redact sensitive items.
Will H: One small nit — can we add a sample S3 lifecycle and object-lock config to the docs? saves engineering support time.
Maria S: Good idea. I'll add that to the docs PR.
security-bot: New policy draft available: key-rotation-guidelines-v1.md (link) :lock: 
Raj P: Thanks — will review and feed into product security reqs.
Will H: Anyone from infra want me to draft the KMS config snippet? Happy to put a quick PR.
Emily K: Yes please, @Will H. That'll help customers onboard faster.
Maria S: OK — next steps: Will to PR KMS snippet; Emily to PR logging FAQ; Maria/Raj to update timelines in customer-facing roadmap. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
